Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild normocytic anemia, mild thrombocytopenia, and mild neutropenia and lymphopenia with relative basophilia. Creatinine is slightly elevated, suggesting possible renal impairment. Liver enzymes and other biochemistry are within normal limits except for low AST. Findings may indicate chronic disease, possible hypoxia-related or hematologic disorder; clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
